summary: Dependency-confusion squat on @inpeek scope beacons host identifiers on install
details: The package is published to the public npm registry under the @inpeek scope and is structured as a dependency-confusion squat against an internal scope. package.json declares a postinstall hook `node./ping.js` that runs on `npm install`. ping.js performs an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded collector https://webhook.site/543e9958-cf24-4b98-b566-c3bff5ab5b0d, carrying the installer's hostname (os.hostname()), OS platform (os.platform()), and Node version (process.version) as query parameters. The main entry throws on require to signal mis-resolution. Any CI job or developer workstation whose resolver pulls @inpeek/odata-angular from the public registry instead of the intended internal source auto-executes the beacon and discloses host identifiers to a third-party collector with no consent and no opt-out.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
